text: Make an app that reminds me about deadlines when I mention a date.
Make an app that notices when I'm going in circles or using a logical fallacy.
Make an app that notices when my last three thoughts have drifted off-topic and shows a card.
Make an app that checks if I already have one before building a new one.
Make an app that tells me to take a pause when voices get loud.
Make an app that shows a card every evening to remind me about a recap.
